title: Error budgets: SLI, SLO, and the argument they replace

videos.script: On the afternoon of the thirtieth, the Billing team broke card charges for an hour. {{hour}} The next morning, two arguments start at once. {{two}} The head of product wants the next feature out this week, as planned. {{feature}} The developers on call want nothing released until the retry is fixed, and the alerts are in place. {{oncall}} Both are right. And without a number between them, the louder one wins. {{louder}} An error budget is that number. The team agreed, months ago, how many bad charges a month the shops can live with. {{agreed}} September used twice that. {{twice}} So the argument is already settled, by a policy both sides signed while nothing was on fire. {{settled}} This lesson is about the indicator, the objective, the budget between them, and the alarm that tells you it is burning. {{lesson}}
